newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot gas oil steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot gas oil steady in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE spot gas oil prices were holding steady on Thursday with benchmark futures offering little fresh direction and the continued strength of the dollar keeping demand from the key German market quiet.
Barge traders said German end-users were buying oil more cheaply from inland refiners leaving demand into the ARA market thin.
Barge premiums were little changed with prompt lifting heating oil barges valued around August IPE +$1 per tonne fob ARA and diesel barges around Aug +$5 after trading at +$4.75 on Wednesday.
Brokers said the log-jam created by a raft of barges waiting to load on the 16th at the Nerefco refinery in Rotterdam was beginning to ease.
0.2 sulphur cargo premiums were around August futures +$1.50 with a prompt cargo traded into Hamburg at the level on Wednesday. Early August cargoes were backwardated around 50 cts.

Diesel cargo premiums were steady around Aug +$4.50 a tonne cif NWE with early August deliveries talked August IPE August IPE +$4.50/+$5.00 a tonne. Ongoing interest for second half August cargoes saw this market traded and valued around $4.75 over the September screen.
